gap_descriptor.definition: PBEsol(+U) band gap of the pristine host as released (not the nsc-dd hybrid gap)

payload.interpretation_caveat: association in this sample, not a mechanism; the two descriptors are correlated.

interpretation_full_budget_mean.gap: positive: a wider-gap oxide goes with a costlier vacancy
interpretation_full_budget_mean.stability: negative: a more stable oxide (more negative formation energy per atom) has a higher vacancy formation energy

payload.model: B0: E_f = a + b * formation_energy + c * band_gap, ordinary least squares (3 coefficients: intercept plus the two slopes)

predictions.tracking_rule: tracked only if < 2000000 bytes, else gitignored with the hash recorded

stability_descriptor.definition: host formation energy per atom from the Materials Project, MP2020-corrected; more negative = more stable oxide
stability_descriptor.locator: K21 Sec. II A and II I; docs/descriptor_taxonomy.csv
